_about: The channels plugged into the studio (docs/MULTI_CHANNEL_PLAN.md phase 2). Each channel's settings live in its own repo at studio/channel.json; channels.py reads them from the checkout found here (env var, then ~/YouTube/<name>, then a sibling folder). channels/<slug>/channel.json is the cached copy used when that checkout isn't on this machine (CI, the cloud): refresh it with `python3 scripts/channels.py sync`. A channel marked `home` here is one whose content lives in this repo itself (studio/channel.json at its root); at most one can be, and with none the studio's root holds no channel's content and every channel is read through its checkout. To add a channel: give its repo a studio/channel.json and add one line here.

studio._about: The studio's own short name. It is not a channel's. It prefixes what the studio installed on the machines under one name: launchd labels (com.<prefix>.*), state and log files, and the <PREFIX>_AGENT and <PREFIX>_THREAD_PR variables. Read with channels.studio_prefix(). Changing it here renames nothing on a machine, so rename there first. `github` is the repo that carries the studio's board and threads (owner/name); it is the one field that changes when the studio moves to its own repo. `default_channel` is the channel of a job or record that names none (old queue rows), and the section of board.json that carries the job queue. `checkouts` (optional) are the folder names under ~/YouTube to look for the studio's own repo in, once no channel is `home`.
